Capricorn nature

Capricorn is ruled by Saturn and is traditionally the sign of discipline, responsibility and long-term ambition. It is associated with patience, a strong sense of duty and the ability to keep climbing steadily towards a goal others gave up on. Capricorn is often described as reserved and serious; it is also said to have a dry humour and to grow warmer and more relaxed with age.

Capricorn in love and work

In love Capricorn is associated with commitment and quiet reliability rather than display. At work it is linked with administration, government, engineering, business and any long career built step by step.

Which sign is mine?

In India, "your rashi" usually means your Vedic Moon sign, which needs your birth time and is often different from the Western sun sign you get from your birthday alone. If you are not sure which you are, the free calculators will tell you both.

Frequently asked

Common questions

Is Capricorn the same as Makar rashi?

Yes — Makar is the Hindi name for the same sign. What can differ is how you work out which sign is yours: by your Western sun sign (22 December – 19 January) or by your Vedic Moon sign, which needs your birth time.

Which planet rules Capricorn?

Saturn. That is why Saturday, the day of Saturn, is traditionally considered Capricorn's day, and why remedies for the sign often involve Saturn.

Which signs are traditionally compatible with Capricorn?

Taurus, Virgo, Cancer are the traditional pairings: the other signs of its element, and the seventh sign, the house of partnership. Real compatibility is judged from two full birth charts through kundli matching, not from signs alone.
